data.long_meaning: The name Obediah is derived from the Hebrew roots ‘obed’ meaning ‘servant’ and ‘yah’ meaning ‘God’. The name can be interpreted as ‘servant of God’. This name was borne by a number of figures in the Old Testament, including a prophet and a Levite. The name Obediah carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Latin. Parents who choose Obediah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obediah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: Obediah’s association with obedient servitude to God resonated deeply with Christians throughout history. During times of religious persecution, the name Obediah became a symbol of resilience, reflecting the unwavering faith and steadfast obedience of those who bore it.

They are expected to represent the essence of a true servant, loyal and committed to serving God’s purpose and following His divine will.
